name: egypt-strategic-advisory
description: Egypt strategic advisory engine for companies going global. Covers macroeconomic analysis, industry trends, competitive landscape, investment site selection, entry modes, risk assessment, political economy outlook, and long-term strategic planning — powered by curated reference corpus and structured databases.

displayDescription.en: Egypt strategic advisory for enterprises expanding to the Middle East and North Africa. Full-spectrum coverage: macroeconomic environment & sovereign risk (GDP growth, inflation, EGP exchange dynamics), industry value chain analysis (manufacturing, energy, ICT, agriculture, construction), competitive landscape & market entry strategy, investment site selection (SCZone, Suez Canal corridor, new administrative capital), political economy risk assessment, Egypt Vision 2030 alignment, and scenario-based long-term planning. Corpus-first approach with curated reference texts and structured databases.
displayDescription.zh: 精通埃及宏观环境、产业趋势、竞争格局和风险管控，提供投资选址、进入模式和长期布局决策建议。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 分析埃及当前的宏观经济环境和投资机会，重点关注Vision 2030相关产业。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Analyze Egypt's macroeconomic environment and investment opportunities, focusing on Vision 2030 priority sectors.
